Quick HSK 1 quiz 🧭

东 (dōng) means east and 西 (xī) means west. Put them together and you get 东西 (dōngxi), one of the most useful words in Chinese. What does it mean?

A) a compass
B) a thing, stuff
C) a map

Comment A, B or C 👇 Small tip: the 西 is said lightly, in the neutral tone.

📤 Send this to someone preparing for the HSK
